policy: An explicit correction revises only the attributed interpretation of an exact result event in the same run. Target the latest correction to revise it again; competing or repeated targets are rejected. Preserve all original records and accounting. Corrections are reconciliation, including after closure or the deadline, and never authorize new execution. Supporting evidence must resolve; attribution and structural validity do not establish truth. References to superseded interpretations become stale, including dependent acceptance. Older readers cannot read runs containing this extension; preserve an export before opting in.
